Abstract excerpt: We introduce BrainNorm, a normative foundation model, trained and tested on ~66,000 T1-weighted structural MRI (T1w sMRI) scans. By leveraging language-image style contrastive pretraining on healthy cohorts across ages, BrainNorm learns a Semantic Atlas Latent space (SAL), where each scan is represented as a set of atlas-parcel embeddings. This yields parcel-specific healthy aging template trajectories that support age-consistent template matching and localized deviation scoring relative to a subject's chronological age.
